title: Data export
subtitle: A complete export of all your business's data – at any time, in open formats.
requested: The export is being produced. It appears in the list as soon as it is ready.
acknowledged: You confirmed you received the export.
requestError: The export could not be requested.
acknowledgeError: The receipt could not be confirmed.
downloadError: The export could not be downloaded.
loadError: The exports could not be loaded.
readOnly: The export is requested by the business's management.
window: A finished export can be downloaded for 7 days; then the file is deleted. A new export can be requested at any time.
acknowledgeHint: Before you leave, you confirm you received the final export. Nexotec offboards a business only with a confirmed export produced after its last change.

contents.title: What the export holds
contents.records: Every record of the business as CSV and JSON, one file per entity, with a description of the schema
contents.documents: Every issued document as PDF, with its number and date
contents.files: The uploaded files: logos, photos, signatures

rowMenu.managersOwn: The business's own export is its management's.

notReady.requested: The export is still being produced.
notReady.failed: This export failed – request a new one.
notReady.expired: The file was deleted after 7 days.

refusals.dealership_offboarded: This business is offboarded. A copy of its archive is produced by Nexotec support.
refusals.export_requested: The export is still being produced.
refusals.export_failed: This export failed – request a new one.
refusals.export_expired: This export's download has expired and its file was deleted. Request a new export.
refusals.export_file_missing: This export's file is no longer there. Request a new export.
refusals.export_not_own: Only the business's own export is acknowledged.
refusals.export_already_acknowledged: This export's receipt is confirmed already.
refusals.staff_use_archive_export: The business's export is its management's. Nexotec produces an archive export under Platform › Offboard a business.
